entries.title: Esther 9:1
segments: The triumph of the wicked is short, and their most confident expectations will come to naught.

entries.title: Esther 9:3
segments: Many are more influenced by the fear of man than by the fear of God; and when rulers are on the side of right, many will externally follow their example.

entries.title: Esther 9:10
segments: The wickedness of parents may prove the occasion of destruction to their children; and efforts to destroy the church of God may ruin not only those who make them, but all who are induced to follow their example.

entries.title: Esther 9:13
segments: The gallows; the one, it is supposed, which Haman had prepared for Mordecai, and on which he was himself hanged.

entries.title: Esther 9:16
segments: One man, by his wickedness, may be instrumental in the destruction of thousands.

entries.title: Esther 9:19
segments:
With the people of God, darkness may endure for a night, but light cometh in the morning. 
 
"Let those that sow in sadness wait Till the fair harvest come; They shall confess their sheaves are great, And shout the blessings home."

entries.title: Esther 9:21
segments: Fourteenth day of the month of Adar; this month answered to part of February and March.  The feast of Purim, or the lot, thus instituted, is observed by the Jews to this day.

entries.title: Esther 9:28
segments: Special mercies demand special thanksgivings to the Author and Finisher of all good, and call us to imitate the Saviour's example in doing good as we have opportunity and ability, to those who may need and feel our influence.

entries.title: Esther 9:29
segments: This second letter of Purim; the first letter mentioned,
, seems to have been more of the nature of a recommendation, but the second letter was authoritative.

entries.title: Esther 9:30
segments: With words of peace and truth; kind words of truth according to the will of God.

entries.title: Esther 9:31
segments: The fastings; to keep in mind those observed by Esther and the Jews.
Their cry; for deliverance from the machinations of their enemies.

entries.title: Esther 9:32
segments: In the book; the records of the acts that were passed on this occasion.
